item.title: Chassidus in Color Releases Coffee Table Book: ‘Geula Edition’
item.description: After two years of creativity, collaboration, and countless hours of learning and artistic exploration, Chassidus in Color is proud to release its very first publication: Chassidus in Color – Geula Edition, a beautifully designed coffee table book that brings Chassidus to life through art. Full Story

item.title: New Weekly Halacha Podcast with Rabbi Braun
item.description: The Lemaan Yilmedu Institute is pleased to announce the launch of Lemaan Yishmeu, a new weekly halacha podcast with Rabbi Yosef Y. Braun, Mara D’asra and member of the Crown Heights Beis Din. Full Story

item.title: Hundreds of Bochurim Participate in ‘Vehogisa’ Exam on Yud Shevat
item.description: Hundreds of bochurim from Lubavitcher Yeshivos across the country gathered in Crown Heights on Wednesday, Yud Shevat, for the Vehogisa Mivchan Kloli, an intensive test covering Gemara material studied throughout the year. Full Story

item.title: Help a Meis Mitzvah Have a Jewish Burial
item.description: A Jewish man passed away in Merced California, with no family involved and was approved for cremation. With great effort, activists are working to transfer him for burial in a New York Cemetery. Full Story

item.title: After Losing His Tefillin, Should I Get My Son an Extra Pair
item.description: From the COLlive inbox: My son recently lost his Alter Rebbe’s ksav Tefillin while on Mivtzoim. Should I replace them with a high and lower-cost pairs? Full Story

item.title: Toronto Women Unite for Annual Taharas Hamishpacha Series
item.description: This winter, Toronto’s Chabad community once again demonstrated its deep commitment to the mitzvah of Taharas Hamishpacha through a powerful and inspiring four-week review series for women. Full Story

item.title: Hiloula of Rabbi Yitzchok Abuhatzeira Celebrated in Crown Heights
item.description: Approximately 60 men joined an impromptu Hiloula organized by the family of Noam Amrami and his parents, at his home on Eastern Parkway this past Motzoei Shabbos. Full Story

item.title: Yud Shvat Farbrengen Unites Sydney Community
item.description: Sydney’s Jewish community gathered in large numbers to mark Yud Shvat at a deeply moving communal farbrengen, jointly hosted by Chabad NSW, Chabad of Bondi, and Tzemach Tzedek, with the participation of the Lazaroff family, who co-hosted the evening as a seudas hodaah. Full Story

item.title: Rebbetzin Mindy Borenstein, OBM
